turns.assessment: The fault is pinned to the first fibre span on S21→S06. The booster (amp0) input and output did not change, while amp1 input and every subsequent amplifier/channel monitor fell by about 8.5 dB, placing the added loss between amp0 and amp1. Persistent partial power and OSNR degradation, without pump-current changes or OSC-loss evidence, supports increased span loss rather than an amplifier failure or fibre cut.

proposals.rationale: E20 is span0 on S21→S06, directly between unchanged booster amp0 and amp1, whose input dropped about 8.5 dB. The same deficit persists through all downstream amplifiers and channels, exactly matching added span loss.

A fault on this span fits the localization, but a cut should cause complete signal and OSC loss and commonly affect both cable fibres; the observed partial 8.5 dB reduction argues strongly against it.
